data_description.access_key_id: Access key ID for the S3 API.
data_description.bucket: Bucket must already exist and be accessible with the provided credentials. Do not include the bucket in the endpoint URL.
data_description.endpoint_url: S3 API endpoint URL, for example https://s3.example.com. Do not append the bucket name. See [Boto3 Session]({boto3_docs_url}) and [AWS S3 endpoints]({aws_s3_docs_url}).
data_description.addressing_style: Use path for providers such as Garage that expect endpoint/bucket/key. Use virtual for bucket.endpoint/key. Auto lets botocore decide.
data_description.secret_access_key: Secret access key for the S3 API.
data_description.region: S3 signing region. For many self-hosted providers this can be us-east-1 or any provider-specific value.
data_description.prefix: Optional key prefix inside the bucket, for example homeassistant/. This is not a URL path and should not start with /.
data_description.verify: Optional path to a PEM CA file for custom TLS certificates. Leave blank for the system trust store.
